tasks.title: Correct signal opportunity sampling and outcome statistics
tasks.goal: Base empirical claims on state transitions, non-overlapping horizons, unique days, and conservative after-cost outcomes.
subgoals: Stop recording identical signal payloads on every broadcast; persist state transitions and scenario changes.
Mark eligible SignalEvent rows as opportunities and exclude legacy rows by default.
Derive non-overlapping samples separately for 15, 30, and 60 minutes.
Add day-clustered bootstrap intervals, walk-forward holdout, after-cost expectancy, MFE, MAE, target-first, invalidation-first, and time-to-target.
Implement INSUFFICIENT, EMERGING, and CALIBRATED evidence gates.
tasks.notes: Completed 2026-08-14. Broadcast persistence now records state/scenario transitions only and marks eligible opportunities; edge_probability remains null. Statistics exclude legacy correlated rows by default, greedily select non-overlapping samples per horizon, and report independent opportunities, unique days, after-cost and holdout expectancy, MFE/MAE, target/invalidation-first rates, and day-clustered intervals. Evidence gates are INSUFFICIENT (<20 opportunities or <10 days), EMERGING, and CALIBRATED (>=50/20 plus positive holdout). Six signal tests pass.
verify_complete: Synthetic overlapping signals collapse to the expected independent counts by horizon.
Statistics report independent opportunities and unique days beside every rate.
Legacy correlated observations are hidden by default and clearly warned when enabled.
Historical Edge cannot affect live bias before CALIBRATED status and positive holdout expectancy.
